title: The World Wakes
start: Speak to Orlando Smith, excavating west of the Legends' Guild, south of Sorcerer's Tower.

recommended.t: 100 Combat, it is recommended that you have balanced combat stats at around level 70 each.
Food (Monkfish or a higher tier food is recommended), weapons and armour
Yew logs or better for a bonfire boost
Combat boosting potions (e.g. super ranging potion or super magic potion)
Prayer-restoring potions (e.g. prayer potion or super restore)

rewards.t: 3 ancient lamps granting 100,000 experience in three different skills at or above level 75 (you may destroy them and get them back from the High Druid)
3 static lamps granting 50000 Combat XP each in any combat skill at or above level 65 (you may destroy them and get them back from the High Druid)
Glossy lamp granting 110000 Slayer XP, requiring 70 Slayer (if you do not have 70 Slayer, you can destroy it and get it back from the High Druid)
Pale lamp granting 250000 Prayer XP, requiring 80 Prayer (if you do not have 80 Prayer, you can destroy it and get it back from the High Druid)
Juna's Gift, Azzanadra's Gift, or Zilyana's Gift (may be changed to either of the three versions for free after the quest by talking to the High Druid)
Access to Guthixian ruins, where you can offer chronicle fragments for Divination experience
Access to the memory of Naragun using fairy ring with code AIS

steps.t: Talk to Orlando Smith, West of the Legends' Guild (fairy code BLR, or use the Ardougne lodestone). [Chat: 1 Can I help at all? › 1 So you just need me to open the doors? › Accept]
p: A museum sic | archaelogist has made a potentially ground-breaking discovery. Join him to explore ancient caverns, fight legendary warriors, and become part of the most important event for thousands…

steps.t: Open the door.
Investigate the following 6 artefacts:
Investigate the Guthixian statue to the east.
Enter the next room to the east and kill the 3 automatons.

sub.t: You must finish the entire dialogue with the Automatons before clicking to attack them (there's a small break in the dialogue) or you will have to redo the cutscene again.
Warning: Automatons can deal high damage to players standing within their special attack range. Lower-level players should use ranged, magic, or necromancy to attack them.

steps.t: Talk to Sliske. [Chat: 3 I, [Player], stand before you! Do your worst! › 1 What does this mean? › 1 What do you mean, trouble? › 1 Okay then.]
Continue talking to Sliske after the cutscene. [Chat: 1 What do you gain from telling me this? › 2 So how do I come into this? › 1 I already know my decision. › Any]
p: Sliske kills Guthix with the Staff of Armadyl
Saradomin appears and teleports the Zarosians away.

steps.t: If Kree'arra and Commander Zilyana don't spawn, talk to Sliske again.
After the cutscenes, talk to Kree'arra. [Chat: 3 Why are you following Zilyana, then? › 3 If you want to get rid of me, you'll have to do it the hard way.]
Defeat Kree'arra. Avoid standing on the tornadoes.
Pass through the door (east).
Run to the other side of the room and activate the control panel. [Chat: 1 Guthix is in trouble. I'm here to protect him.]

While using the control panel you can release a boulder by clicking on the dispenser in the corner of the screen. The goal is to get the boulder from the dispenser to the receptacle tile (circular cavity with a green dot).
To solve the puzzle:

sub.t: Rotate the tracks to create a path from the dispenser to the green hole, matching the solutions below (NOTE: puzzle can crash based on camera settings try classic)
Click the appropriate dispenser to release the boulder
When the boulder halts at a gate, wait for the next tile to auto-rotate such that the path continues, and click the gates to release the boulder at the right time

p: The solution to the first puzzle. Click the top-right dispenser.
The solution to the second puzzle. Click the bottom-right dispenser.
The solution to the third puzzle. Click the top-left dispenser.
The solution to the fourth puzzle. Click the bottom-left dispenser.

steps.t: After the cutscenes (skippable), view the strange map to the east.
p: The door puzzle after successfully balancing all four categories

steps.t: Answer four randomised questions to balance the pillars (Chaos, Order, Good, and Evil must all be exactly 50%). Refer to the below table and pick the appropriate answers:
Give the group a motivational speech [Chat: 1 Enthuse the group. › 1 Reinforce the importance of protecting the edicts. › 1 Highlight the strengths of the group.]
p: The most optimal solution for the storage rooms

steps.t: Drag the guardian icons to the correct threat based on the hover text in the top row:
Talk to Juna. [Chat: 1 I've finished setting up. › 1 I'm happy with the formation for now.]
Finish the dialogue after the cutscene (including a pause in dialogue) or you will be forced to watch it again.
Drink from the elixirs if you need to restore your health or prayer.
Note: you can bank if you talk to Druidess. Look for the bank icon on the minimap.
Enter the north-west storage wing guarded by Chaeldar and Thaerisk Cemphier. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm sure. Let's go.]
Defeat General Graardor. Protect from Melee is preferred.
p: General Graardor using his "Graardor protect" attack.

steps.t: Enter the exit.
Enter the north storage wing guarded by Cres. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm sure. Let's go.]
Defeat Zemouregal. Bringing Antipoison is recommended.
Enter the exit.
Enter the south-west storage wing guarded by Death. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'm sure. Let's go.]
Defeat K'ril Tsutsaroth. Be aware of his special attacks.
p: K'ril activates his most dangerous attack.

steps.t: Enter the exit.
Enter the south storage wing guarded by Fiara and Valluta.
Defeat Enakhra.
Enter the exit.
Talk to Cres in the center.
Talk to Juna in the east.
Defend Juna from the spiritual enemies for 2 minutes.
p: Defending Juna until Cres can engage Zilyana.

steps.t: Talk to Azzanadra after the skippable cutscene. [Chat: Any › Any]
Enter the shattered wall.
Run down the path, avoiding the boulders and flames. If you get trapped between ice spikes, click them to break free.
After the skippable cutscene, walk east down to the pedestal in front of Guthix. He will teleport you.
Walk between the islands, talking to Guthix along the way. [Chat: Any]
On your return, talk to one of the guardians. [Chat: Any › Any]
After a skippable cutscene, Saradomin will appear in front of you. Talk to him. [Chat: Any › Any]
Talk to Juna (10 free inventory slots are required).
Quest complete!
p: Zilyana kills Cres, mistaking him for Guthix
